text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, look at all this snow! That's a long
climb to be carrying
precious cargo...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
(Trainer told me that this was a trial to
help me find my strengths. Not
to mention,
McQueen is waiting for this generator at
the summit.)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
All righty! She helped me out at the
scrimmage, so now it's my turn!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Well then, all that is left for us is to wait. I'm quite surprised. I never expected someone to ask for such eccentric training with this much fervor.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I suppose this is proof of how badly you
wish to discover Kita's
abilities... However,
she will not complete her journey.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Climbing a snowy mountain with a
generator in tow is a task that
would
exhaust most Umamusume by the third
station. And since Kita
hasn't even
debuted yet...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff... So... heavy... This might be tougher... than carrying portable shrines.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
But... I won't give up. This mountain won't
beat me!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Taking Kita's current faculties into
account... I believe she will make it
up to
the fifth station.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Though as she is now, she possesses
no exceptional abilities.
Still... I sense
something within her that I cannot express
in words.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Something akin to natural talent. That
alone will bring her to the
fourth station,
and her fortitude will bring her to the fifth.
But that's
it. Still, it's plenty respectable.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Urgh... Getting dizzy... I'm only about
halfway, too. Is this... my limit?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Trainer... went out of their way to arrange
this training for me.
McQueen's waiting for
me. Can I... stop here?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
(No, I have to keep going. I have to return
the favor. Dad and his
pupils would never
leave a debt unpaid.)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
(Repay your debts. Put one foot in front of
the other. If I'm not going
all out, all the
time, then I'm not being true to myself! All
righty...)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Haaaaah! I won't give up heeere! I'll keep
going—going all out—until
the very end!
Hi-yaaah, grrr-raaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
The sun has already begun to set... It is
about time for us to bring this
to a close.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
In all likelihood, Kita has retired near the
fifth station. I will contact
my support staff
and have them bring her down to the base
camp.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Wh-what is the matter? Something
happen?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: McQueen, sorry for being late! Here's... your generator! Huff, huff, huff...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
K-Kita! You made it here... all by
yourself?!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! It was way tougher than I expected
though, so it took me some
time.
Hopefully, I've returned the favor a little
bit now!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, thanks for letting me do this! So,
um... do you think you've
figured out what
my strengths are?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to this rather intense trial, Kitasan
Black's strengths are clear
to me now.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She has the physique to climb a mountain
with heavy baggage, the
recovery speed
to rely on only short breaks, and the will
to never give
up. In other words...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Grit! So that's my strength!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
There is no doubt about it. I have never
seen an Umamusume with the
grit to
complete a mission as ridiculous as this
one.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I see, I see. But, will grit be useful during
races? It doesn't have to do
much with
speed, right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Before she races? If it involves preparing
for a race... Ah! I believe I
understand.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
You wish to have Kita go through rigorous
training, during which she
can create her
own secret weapon, correct? Just like
Bourbon did?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yay! Sounds good to me! Train me to your
heart's content! I want to
become someone
who'll never lose again—ever!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Trainer, McQueen, thank you both so much! I feel like I'm starting to see the light at the end of the tunnel!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: I'm going to train like crazy and develop my own weapon—something only I can use. And once I have that, I want to try it out in a race against her.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I want to see if my weapon will work
against my idol—Tokai Teio!
